topic: Tabiiy xamirturushli (sourdough) non va fitin kislotasi ilmi

quiz.question: Tabiiy xamirturushli xamirda fitin kislotasi qanchagacha parchalanishi mumkin?
quiz.explanation: Sekin fermentatsiyalangan tabiiy xamirturushli xamirda fitin kislotasi 90% gacha parchalanadi va minerallar so‘rilishi ortadi.
